why.en: Shows the TGT and service tickets your machine currently holds.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki aapki machine ke paas abhi kaunse TGT aur service tickets hain.

expect.en: On a domain-joined PC you see a krbtgt/DOMAIN ticket and tickets like cifs/server with start and end times (about 10 hours). On a non-domain machine it says there are no tickets. Output varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: Domain-joined PC par krbtgt/DOMAIN ticket aur cifs/server jaise tickets start aur end time (lagbhag 10 hours) ke saath dikhte hain. Non-domain machine par bolta hai ki tickets nahi hain. Output machine ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

why.en: Kerberos clients locate the KDC through DNS SRV records on port 88.
why.hinglish: Kerberos clients KDC ko DNS SRV records se dhoondte hain, port 88 ke liye.

expect.en: On a domain network you get the DC host names and port 88. For example.com the answer is usually empty, which is fine. Results vary.
expect.hinglish: Domain network par DC ke host names aur port 88 milte hain. example.com ke liye answer aksar khaali hota hai, jo theek hai. Results alag ho sakte hain.

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap and see the AS, TGS and AP messages.
why.hinglish: Download kiya .pcap kholo aur AS, TGS aur AP messages dekho.

expect.en: You see AS-REQ, KRB-ERROR (25), AS-REP, TGS-REQ and TGS-REP packets in the same order as the lesson steps.
expect.hinglish: Aapko AS-REQ, KRB-ERROR (25), AS-REP, TGS-REQ aur TGS-REP packets lesson ke steps ke order mein dikhte hain.

why.en: Filters only the error replies such as 25 and 24.
why.hinglish: Sirf error replies filter karta hai jaise 25 aur 24.

expect.en: Packets with KRB-ERROR show the error code, for example 25 PREAUTH_REQUIRED in the normal flow and 24 PREAUTH_FAILED in the wrong-password flow.
expect.hinglish: KRB-ERROR wale packets error code dikhate hain, jaise normal flow mein 25 PREAUTH_REQUIRED aur wrong-password flow mein 24 PREAUTH_FAILED.
